name: Suez Canal
description: An artificial sea-level waterway in Egypt connecting the Mediterranean Sea to the Red Sea through the Isthmus of Suez, providing the shortest maritime route between Europe and the lands around the Indian and western Pacific oceans.

name: Panama Canal
description: An artificial 82 km waterway in Panama that connects the Atlantic Ocean with the Pacific Ocean, cutting across the Isthmus of Panama and drastically reducing maritime voyage duration around Cape Horn.

name: Strait of Gibraltar
description: A narrow strait that connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Mediterranean Sea and separates the Iberian Peninsula in Europe from Morocco in Africa. Guarded historically by the Pillars of Hercules.

name: Strait of Malacca
description: A narrow stretch of water between the Malay Peninsula and the Indonesian island of Sumatra. As the main shipping channel between the Indian and Pacific Oceans, it is one of the most important maritime shipping lanes in the world.

name: Bosporus Strait
description: A narrow, natural strait and an internationally significant waterway in northwestern Turkey that forms part of the continental boundary between Europe and Asia, dividing Istanbul into European and Asian sectors.

name: Bering Strait
description: A strait between the Pacific and Arctic oceans, separating the Chukchi Peninsula of the Russian Far East from the Seward Peninsula of Alaska. Site of the prehistoric Beringia land bridge facilitating human migration to the Americas.
